heading: Get Upto ₹50 Cashback on using Amazon Pay
terms:

heading: Flat ₹150 or ₹15 cashback with Jupiter UPI
description: Earn cashback in the form of Jewels on the Jupiter App on orders above ₹199
terms:
- Offer valid only for users who create a Jupiter account and complete their first
successful transaction via Jupiter UPI on Zepto

- This offer can be availed in conjunction with any ongoing offers or promotions
running on Zepto.

- Cashback will be credited in the form of Jupiter Jewels, which can be viewed and
redeemed by logging into the Jupiter app

- Jupiter Jewels can be redeemed for a wide range of products and services within
the Jupiter app, including Flat Cashback, bill payments, Digi Gold, and more.

- Offer valid once per user unless specified otherwise.

- Jupiter reserves the right to modify, extend, or withdraw the offer at its sole
discretion without prior notice.

- This offer is exclusively for new users who join the Jupiter platform through this
specific promotion. Existing users are not eligible.

- Terms and conditions of the Jupiter Jewels program apply.

heading: Get upto ₹100 Cashback using Paytm UPI
description: Valid on orders above ₹299. T&C apply
terms:
- Users receive ₹50 cashback on their first-ever Paytm transaction.
- To qualify, both new and existing Paytm users must make a transaction of ₹299 or more using Paytm UPI during the offer period.
- Eligible users will receive a scratch card in the Paytm app, valid for 2 days from the date of issue.
- Cashback amount will be credited to the user's UPI-linked bank account within 24 hours of scratching the card.
- This offer can be availed only once per user during the campaign period.
- Standard Paytm terms and conditions apply
